subject: Supplier activation: PO token issuance & line-item reallocation for Cloudway
messages:
From: Daniel Hayes <daniel.hayes@cloudway.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudway.io
Date: 2026-02-19T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor setup / PO needed to activate Cloudway account

Hi Lauren / Monica,

We're ready on our side to go live with the Redwood integration but need a PO reference and any spend cap guidance before we can turn on billing. We've attached our standard vendor onboarding form and a contact for AP (accounts-payable@cloudway.io).

Quick answers to your usual questions:
- Monthly expected spend (initial): ~$45k
- Primary billing contact: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cloudway.io>

Can you confirm the PO format you need and whether Redwood issues a single PO with line items or a split PO per SKU? We filled and attached the onboarding form (cloudway_onboarding_form.pdf).

Thanks,
Daniel Hayes
Partnerships Lead | Cloudway
attachments: cloudway_onboarding_form.pdf

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Daniel Hayes <daniel.hayes@cloudway.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-19T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup / PO needed to activate Cloudway account

Hi Daniel — thanks for the quick turnaround and the form. A few items we need to complete vendor setup and issue the PO:

1) Completed vendor setup form (we have most fields but need the company W-9 and legal entity name to match tax records).
2) Confirmed line-item descriptions and SKU mapping (our finance team requires clear mappings for cost center allocation).
3) Preferred PO spend cap (if you expect spikes, tell us the absolute monthly cap).

Process note: Redwood usually issues a single PO number for the vendor with multiple line items underneath. We can split to two line items if you need separate accounting treatment, but the PO number remains the primary reference. If you need a spend cap above $50k/month we'll need finance approval.

Can you upload the filled onboarding form and a W-9 to the Drive link below or reply with them attached? Once we have those we can provision a provisional PO token for onboarding (used to activate the account) and then convert it to a committed PO after approvals.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aCloudwayOnboardingDraft

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
attachments: (none)

From: Daniel Hayes <daniel.hayes@cloudway.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@cloudway.io, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-20T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup / PO needed to activate Cloudway account

Lauren — attaching the requested documents.

We attached: cloudway_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, cloudway_w9.pdf.

Proposal for PO line items:
- Line 1: Integration fees (SKU: CW-INTEG-BASE) — $25,000/month
- Line 2: Usage overage (SKU: CW-USG-ONDEMAND) — estimated $20,000/month (billed against the same PO)

Requested provisional spend cap: $75,000/month to allow for onboarding spikes in month 1. Billing contact is Maria Lopez (maria.lopez@cloudway.io).

Let us know if the line descriptions need rewording to match Redwood's internal chart of accounts — happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Daniel
attachments: cloudway_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, cloudway_w9.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-21T10:11:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Supplier activation: PO token issuance & line-item reallocation for Cloudway

Looping Ben in for commercial sign-off on the requested spend cap. Finance note: anything > $50k/month requires a quick exec approval and cost-center assignment.

Suggested PO configuration:
- Single PO number (master) with two line items as proposed by the vendor.
- Map Line 1 -> Cost Center 4100 (Partner Integrations)
- Map Line 2 -> Cost Center 4200 (Variable Usage)

If legal/accounting want a different naming convention for the line items, we should ask Daniel to mirror the SKU labels exactly; we can then re-label in our system but prefer one-to-one mapping at issuance.

Please confirm if we should approve a provisional spend cap of $75k for month 1. I'll prepare the PO token (format REDW-PO-2026-0142) pending sign-off.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
attachments: (none)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Daniel Hayes <daniel.hayes@cloudway.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-23T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: PO issued: REDW-PO-2026-0142 — please confirm line item wording

Daniel — thanks for the docs and patience. Finance approved a provisional spend cap of $75,000 for month 1. We've issued the PO token: REDW-PO-2026-0142. See attached stub (po_REDW-PO-2026-0142.pdf).

PO breakdown (as issued):
- REDW-PO-2026-0142 / Line 1 — Integration fees — SKU: CW-INTEG-BASE — $25,000/month — Cost Center: 4100
- REDW-PO-2026-0142 / Line 2 — Usage overage (on-demand) — SKU: CW-USG-ONDEMAND — up to $50,000/month — Cost Center: 4200

Notes:
- This is a provisional PO for onboarding. We will convert to a committed PO after the first billing cycle and DocuSign acceptance.
- Please confirm that the line item wording is acceptable and acknowledge receipt of the PO. If you need different SKU strings for your system, reply with the exact labels and we'll reissue quickly.

Attachments: po_REDW-PO-2026-0142.pdf

Best regards,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0199
attachments: po_REDW-PO-2026-0142.pdf
